ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure has upper and lower schematic sections of land-sea distribution along the 20° latitude line. The upper horizontal line is marked with about 75°, 80°, and 85°, the middle is labeled “A,” the left-side sea area is labeled ①, and the right-side sea area is labeled ②; the question stem states that between ①—② is land, and the remaining two sides are ocean. The lower horizontal line is marked with about 70°, 55°, and 40°, with the values decreasing to the right, the middle is labeled “B,” the left-side sea area is labeled ③, and the right-side sea area is labeled ④; the question stem states that between ③—④ is land, and the remaining two sides are ocean. Then reason: The upper section near 75°E—85°E and the 20° latitude line corresponds to the vicinity of the Indian Peninsula; in the lower section, the longitude decreases from 70° to 40° toward the right, so it should be west longitude, and the 20° latitude line passes through South America, so B should be South America. Thus ③ is located offshore of the west coast of South America, and ④ is located offshore of the east coast of South America. The west coast of South America is affected by the Peru Current and coastal upwelling; nutrients rise upward, forming a famous fishing ground. Therefore, the place where upwelling exists and forms a fishing ground is sea area ③.

Between 1—2 and between 3—4 is land, and the remaining two sides are ocean. <image1> In which sea area in the figure does upwelling exist, thereby forming a fishing ground?
ready3_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure has upper and lower schematic sections of land-sea distribution along the 20° latitude line. The upper horizontal line is marked with about 75°, 80°, and 85°, the middle is labeled “A,” the left-side sea area is labeled ①, and the right-side sea area is labeled ②; the question stem states that between ①—② is land, and the remaining two sides are ocean. The lower horizontal line is marked with about 70°, 55°, and 40°, with the values decreasing to the right, the middle is labeled “B,” the left-side sea area is labeled ③, and the right-side sea area is labeled ④; the question stem states that between ③—④ is land, and the remaining two sides are ocean. Then reason: The upper section near 75°E—85°E and the 20° latitude line corresponds to the vicinity of the Indian Peninsula; in the lower section, the longitude decreases from 70° to 40° toward the right, so it should be west longitude, and the 20° latitude line passes through South America, so B should be South America. Thus ③ is located offshore of the west coast of South America, and ④ is located offshore of the east coast of South America. The west coast of South America is affected by the Peru Current and coastal upwelling; nutrients rise upward, forming a famous fishing ground. Therefore, the place where upwelling exists and forms a fishing ground is sea area ③.
